{{Quote|Isn't the New Republic getting ready to jump to Reecee?|Leia Organa Solo to Han Solo|<ref name="SBS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
'''Reecee''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], located near the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]].

==History==
Reecee was a heaven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the [[New Republic era]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> [[25 ABY/Legends|Shortly before]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] traveled to the [[Riebold's Foam and Sizzle]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Reecee to gain information on [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Lando's Folly|operation]] at [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]].<ref name="VP" />

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Reecee|conquered]] the planet shortly before taking [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. The attack generated large amounts of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Death/Legends|casualties]], with only several [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] battle groups escaping the carnage.<ref name="SBS" />
